hypothesised_pattern: The target rises with |x4| (either sign) and also with strongly negative x5, so it is high when |x4| > 1 or x5 << 0 and low when x4 is small and x5 is near zero or positive.
rationale: Rows with |x4| of 1.10 and 1.51 have targets of 0.67-0.72, and the row with x4 = 0.01 still reaches 0.67 because x5 = -2.61; x4 = 0.58 with x5 = -1.64 gives 0.50 despite x1 = -3.08. By contrast, x4 = -0.75 with x5 = 1.17 gives 0.25 and small-x4 rows with mild x5 (-0.64, -1.31) give 0.24-0.30, so negative x5 only matters strongly at large magnitude.
